summary: First full test of the Pizzaiolo app (Expo + FastAPI). Backend: 15/15 pytest tests pass. They cover login for all 3 users (wrong password -> 401), /auth/me, menu (3 items with correct prices), tables (10 tables; kitchen gets 403), order create (total computed, no _id), filters by table and by active, the status flow (kitchen new->preparing->ready, waiter ready->served, illegal transitions -> 400, unknown id -> 404), validation (table 11 or empty items -> 422, unknown menu or voice note -> 400), voice-note upload (<2KB -> 400, kitchen -> 403, a sine wav returns transcript ''), and audio fetch (?token and Bearer both 200 with identical bytes, no token -> 401, unknown id -> 404). Frontend at mobile size 375x667: everything requested works. Login role cards prefill the username, a wrong password shows an error, the 10-table grid shows status, adding pizzas, removing one and the total (39 -> 27 €) are correct, the voice modal opens and closes on backdrop tap, sending shows a toast and the active order, the kitchen chips show counts, the voice-note ticket shows the transcript and an Anhören button (the audio GET returned 200), and advance buttons move tickets new->preparing->ready. The waiter then sees the 'Abholbereit' banner and status, 'Als serviert markieren' frees the table, and logout works for both roles. Deprecated packages detected: none (expo-audio is used, not expo-av).

minor.issue: get_object raises requests.HTTPError when the storage fetch fails. Nothing catches it, so the user gets a bare 500 instead of a 502 with a German message (unlike the upload endpoint).
No DELETE endpoint for voice notes. Test uploads and abandoned recordings (re-record or modal closed without saving) pile up in storage and the DB.

ui_bugs.issue: A 'Neue Bestellung eingegangen' toast appears right after kitchen login even though no new order came in. Cause: lastNew is null and q.data is undefined on the first render, so the baseline is set to 0. When the first fetch returns, for example 3 new orders, 3 > 0 fires the toast and haptic. Fix: only set the baseline once q.data is defined (skip while q.isLoading). Reference: /app/frontend/app/kitchen.tsx:54-61

issues: The status chips are 36px tall, below the 44px minimum touch target (kitchen.tsx:210).
On a 375px width the 'Fertig' chip is cut off at the right edge, so users have to scroll sideways to reach it. Consider flex:1 chips or a shorter label.
Item notes only show when voice_note_id is set (kitchen.tsx:161). An item with note_text but no voice note, which the API allows, shows its text nowhere in the kitchen.

action_items: Fix the spurious 'Neue Bestellung eingegangen' toast on first kitchen load (kitchen.tsx:54-61): ignore the first loaded dataset when setting the baseline.
Make the kitchen status chips at least 44px tall and make sure all 3 chips fit on 375px width.
Show note_text on kitchen tickets even without voice_note_id (kitchen.tsx:161).
Wrap get_object in voice_audio with try/except and return a 502 with a German message.
critical_code_review_comments: Every logged-in user can fetch every voice note. That is acceptable for a single restaurant.
The kitchen move mutation's isPending disables every advance button at once while one request is running. This is minor.
Audio playback can't be heard in headless mode. The button's GET returned 200 with audio bytes, but the label stayed 'Anhören'. Verify playback on a device or emulator.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested flows (one medium toast bug)

seed_data_creation: I created TEST orders on tables 7, 9 and 5 and moved all of them to 'served', so none are active. 3 TEST voice notes (sine wavs) remain because there is no delete endpoint. The existing table 3 order was left untouched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run with: export EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL from frontend/.env; pytest /app/backend/tests/test_pizzaiolo_api.py. The frontend env var is EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (not EXPO_BACKEND_URL). Recording can't be tested headless.
rca_of_issue: Kitchen toast on login: the useEffect baseline lastNew is set to 0 while data is still undefined, so the first real data counts as 'new'.
